title: Prusa i3 MK3S Digital Twin (replay benchmark)

targets.rawSql: SELECT time_bucket('1 second', time) AS time, avg(t_hotend) AS "actual", avg(t_hotend_sp) AS "setpoint" FROM telemetry WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND printer_id = 1 AND t_hotend IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT time_bucket('1 second', time) AS time, avg(p_hotend) AS "hotend W", avg(p_bed) AS "bed W" FROM telemetry WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND printer_id = 1 AND p_hotend IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT time_bucket('1 second', t_db) AS time, count(*) AS "rows/s" FROM telemetry WHERE $__timeFilter(t_db) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: End-to-end latency, MQTT publish -> DB (ms, p95 per second)

targets.rawSql: SELECT time_bucket('1 second', t_db) AS time, percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY (extract(epoch from t_db) - t_pub) * 1000) AS "p95 latency" FROM telemetry WHERE $__timeFilter(t_db) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT count(DISTINCT printer_id) AS printers FROM telemetry WHERE time > now() - interval '10 seconds'
SELECT extract(epoch from (now() - max(t_db))) AS age FROM telemetry
